# The fund sale again, linked by `txn_guid:` alone.
#
# The two spellings reach the same place, so the check belongs on the split
# about to move rather than on the words that chose it. `txn_guid:` alone
# leaves the run to find the one side that is not the bank — which is the
# fund's — and it must be refused there too.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal naming the account, with the units
# still on it.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
invoice "INV-USD-001"
  customer_id: "C-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-01-05
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-05
    description: "Consulting"
    action: "Hours"
    account: "Income:Sales"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-05
    due: 2026-02-05
    ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
    memo: "Invoice INV-USD-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-03-18
    amount: 100
    account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
    txn_guid: "5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c"
